summary: Phase 1 audit of src/provider/gemini.rs, mod.rs, discovery.rs: 4 findings (1 High panic, 2 Medium, 1 Low); discovery.rs and most of gemini request translation clean.

files.description: Gemini adapter: request translation, SSE parsing, response shaping (audited 1-535)
Provider enum dispatch, http_client, retry_after, collect_stream, content_text, build_providers (audited 1-251)
Model discovery probes: openai-models-list, ollama, implicit ollama (audited 1-166)

architecture: provider/mod.rs defines the Provider enum dispatching to per-API adapters (openai.rs, responses.rs, anthropic.rs, gemini.rs). Shared helpers: http_client() (15s connect / 120s read-idle), retry_after() (Retry-After header → Duration, cap 60s, default 2s), RateLimited error consumed by runtime retry logic, collect_stream() byte sink, content_text() OpenAI content extractor used by all translators. gemini.rs translates OpenAI wire requests → Gemini generateContent (role folding, tool-name mangling, systemInstruction) and parses ?alt=sse via a newline-framed unfold state machine. discovery.rs probes /models and /api/tags (called from api.rs:97/229), synthesizing an implicit ollama provider when unconfigured.
report:
coverage:
- src/provider/gemini.rs:1-535 (full: translate_request 57-295, chat_stream 297-316, chat 318-360, mangle/unmangle 352-361, gemini_to_openai 363-415, gemini_events 417-535)
- src/provider/mod.rs:1-251 (full: retry_after 37-46, http_client 54-64, Provider::new/dispatch 66-176, build_providers 196-215, collect_stream 217-226, content_text 228-251)
- src/provider/discovery.rs:1-166 (full)
- Cross-refs: api.rs:96-99, 228-232, 500-506 (discover_all and collect_stream callers); retry_after call sites in anthropic.rs:358,394, responses.rs:237,255, gemini.rs:302,336.

FINDING 1 [High] — Negative or NaN Retry-After header panics the turn. location: src/provider/mod.rs:38-46. category: error-handling/boundary.
Evidence (verbatim):
    let secs = resp
        .headers()
        .get("retry-after")
        .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())
        .and_then(|v| v.parse::<f64>().ok())
        .unwrap_or(2.0);
    std::time::Duration::from_secs_f64(secs.min(60.0))
Scenario: upstream or an intermediate proxy returns 429/503 with 'Retry-After: -1' (or 'NaN'). '"-1"'.parse::<f64>() succeeds; .min(60.0) clamps only the upper bound; Duration::from_secs_f64 panics on negative/NaN. The panic unwinds out of chat_stream (gemini.rs:302, anthropic.rs:358/394, responses.rs:237/255) inside the request task → turn aborted by panic instead of the intended backoff. Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint a user configures can trigger it.
Fix: reject non-finite/negative before conversion: if !(secs.is_finite() && secs > 0.0) { secs = 2.0 }.

FINDING 2 [Medium] — Gemini safety block silently becomes an empty assistant message (non-stream) / generic error (stream); blockReason discarded in both. location: src/provider/gemini.rs:394-397 (gemini_to_openai) and 520-534 (gemini_events EOF path). category: correctness.
Evidence (verbatim):
    let finish_reason = match v["candidates"][0]["finishReason"].as_str() {
        Some("STOP") if !tool_calls.is_empty() => "tool_calls",
        Some("MAX_TOKENS") => "length",
        _ => "stop",
    };
    // gemini_events EOF path: Err(anyhow::anyhow!("stream ended without finishReason"))
Scenario: prompt blocked by safety filters → 200 response with only promptFeedback.blockReason, no candidates. Non-stream: candidates[0] yields nothing, finish_reason falls to "stop", content "" — client sees a successful empty reply indistinguishable from a model choosing silence. Stream: generic 'stream ended without finishReason' masks the real blockReason. promptFeedback is never read anywhere in the file (grep-verified).
Fix: read v["promptFeedback"]["blockReason"] in both paths; non-stream → error or distinguished finish_reason carrying blockReason; stream → include blockReason in the truncation error.

FINDING 3 [Medium] — collect_stream buffers the whole stream with no byte cap. location: src/provider/mod.rs:217-226. category: resource-exhaustion.
Evidence (verbatim):
    let mut buf = Vec::new();
    while let Some(chunk) = s.next().await {
        buf.extend_from_slice(&chunk?);
    }
    Ok(buf)
Scenario: passthrough (api.rs:502-505) bounds only by tokio timeout(30s) — a fast upstream streams hundreds of MB within 30s straight into buf. Error-body reads in openai.rs:216/273/290 have no timeout at all; a drip-feeding upstream staying under the 120s read-idle window grows the Vec unboundedly → daemon memory exhaustion.
Fix: enforce a max-bytes guard independent of caller time bounds; error past cap.

FINDING 4 [Low] — unmangle fallback corrupts tool names containing literal '__'. location: src/provider/gemini.rs:355-361. category: correctness/edge.
Evidence (verbatim):
    names
        .get(name)
        .cloned()
        .unwrap_or_else(|| name.replacen("__", ".", 1))
Scenario: a dot-free tool legitimately named 'my__tool' that misses the per-request names map (upstream-invented call, or chat()/chat_stream() map divergence) is rewritten to 'my.tool', matching no registered tool → dispatch fails. The fallback assumes __ only originates from mangling.
Fix: fall back to the identity; mangle() is a no-op for dot-free names.

clean:
- discovery.rs:1-166 entirely — probe URLs derive only from operator config (cfg.base_url, OLLAMA_HOST env), never response bodies; discovered ids are used only for exact-match routing, not URL/header construction; probes have hard 5s timeout; header secret refs are resolved or skipped (literal refs never sent); implicit ollama synthesis fails closed. No cache exists, so no staleness bug (recomputed per refresh, api.rs:229).
- gemini.rs:57-295 translate_request: role folding, empty-parts dropping, call_names mapping, systemInstruction extraction, generationConfig/toolConfig translation — correct on review.
- gemini.rs:417-535 SSE state machine: newline framing is UTF-8-safe (0x0A never occurs inside multibyte sequences), mid-stream error objects surfaced as Err, EOF-without-newline tail re-fed, running usage emitted once, thought-part routing — no defects beyond finding 2.
- mod.rs:54-64 http_client timeouts applied and used by all adapters; mod.rs:66-176 secret resolution/dispatch; mod.rs:196-215 build_providers failure collection correct and intentional; mod.rs:228-251 content_text drops non-text parts per documented contract.
- Examined, judged non-defects: gemini.rs:54 model interpolated unencoded into URL (same-origin to configured upstream); assistant arguments string-parse failure → json!({}) (gemini.rs:186-192) is lossy but avoids erroring on valid flows.

notes: Did not audit openai.rs/responses.rs/anthropic.rs bodies beyond retry_after call sites (other scouts' scope). No cargo check run — pure static read, read-only audit. OLLAMA_HOST env origin is operator-controlled, so no SSRF surface found in discovery.
